Kerala HC Suspends Ex-DGP's Jail Sentence in Corruption Case

The Kerala High Court has suspended the four-year jail sentence of former DGP Tomin J. Thachankary in a disproportionate assets case. The court's findings on Thachankary's wealth were noted despite the suspension of his sentence.
